svg.title: From Borrower File to Retained Brokerage Fee
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-placement-workflow; chart type: process_flow; title: From Borrower File to Retained Brokerage Fee; subtitle: Five operating stages; loan principal never enters brokerage revenue.; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: The brokerage arranges commercial financing rather than funding loans. Revenue consists only of retained origination or referral fees earned under the applicable agreement. First-deal planning remains 3–9 months; stage numbers indicate sequence, not duration.; caption: A signed term sheet is neither a closing nor earned cash. Track failed closings and commission-reversal exposure separately.; stages: label: Qualify the mandate; value: 1 | Scope and eligibility; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Record borrower jurisdiction, business purpose, financing amount, collateral, and requested timing in HubSpot. Confirm the brokerage can perform the proposed activity before accepting a fee-bearing engagement.; label: Assemble the credit file; value: 2 | Evidence and permissions; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Collect financial statements, bank records, debt schedules, equipment invoices or receivables aging, and authorized contact details. Use a restricted document portal rather than forwarding borrower files through shared inboxes.; label: Match the lender matrix; value: 3 | Credit fit before submission; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Filter Airtable lender records by geography, ticket size, industry, collateral, leverage, and lender-defined coverage requirements. Record each decline reason and permission to share the file with each selected lender.; label: Coordinate credit and closing; value: 4 | Conditions and fee evidence; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Maintain a closing-condition checklist and reconcile borrower-facing fees with lender agreements. The lender owns underwriting and funding; the broker verifies compensation terms, payor identity, and reversal triggers.; label: Reconcile and service; value: 5 | Retained fees and renewals; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Match the earned-fee record to the lender settlement statement and bank receipt. Separate contingent amounts, track clawback windows, and schedule renewal outreach without representing loan principal as operator sales.

rect.title: label: Match the lender matrix; value: 3 | Credit fit before submission; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Filter Airtable lender records by geography, ticket size, industry, collateral, leverage, and lender-defined coverage requirements. Record each decline reason and permission to share the file with each selected lender.

rect.title: label: Coordinate credit and closing; value: 4 | Conditions and fee evidence; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Maintain a closing-condition checklist and reconcile borrower-facing fees with lender agreements. The lender owns underwriting and funding; the broker verifies compensation terms, payor identity, and reversal triggers.

Assumptions: The brokerage arranges commercial financing rather than funding loans. Revenue consists only of retained origination or referral fees earned under the applicable agreement. First-deal planning remains 3–9 months; stage numbers indicate sequence, not duration.
